06 / GOOD TO KNOW

A few details
before we detail.

Still have a question?
Let’s talk ↗

Do I need to provide water or electricity?

For this example service, access to a water tap and standard power outlet is requested. Include any access limitations in your quote request so arrangements can be confirmed before booking.

How long will my detail take?

Allow 1–2 hours for Basic, 3–4 hours for Full, and 5–7 hours for Premium. Vehicle size and condition can change the time required; your quote will include an estimate.

Can you remove every stain and scratch?

Results depend on the surface and the depth of the damage. Deep scratches and permanent stains may require specialist repair. We’ll discuss realistic expectations before work starts.

What happens if it rains?

Outdoor detailing needs suitable weather. If conditions won’t allow a quality finish, we’ll arrange another time or discuss a suitable covered location.

How do I book an appointment?

Choose a package and complete the quote form. This demo prepares your request locally; it does not send a booking or reserve a time.
